desc:
Welcome to Wrap and Bounce an Egg! 🥚

UPDATES EVERY SATURDAY!

🎁 Wrap your Egg to give it more Health!
🏀 Throw it and watch it Bounce through the Zones!
💥 Every Zone hits harder - the farther it goes, the rarer the Animal!
🐣 Break the Egg to hatch a random Animal!
🏃 Grab it and escape back to your Base!
💸 Your Animals earn Cash - even offline! 💤
⚡ Unlock better Wraps and stronger Throws!
🏆 Collect them all in the Index!

❤️ Like the game and join the group for free rewards!


Tags: Egg, Bounce, Skipping, Wrap, Throw, Hatch, Animals, Pets, Cute, Rare, Collect, Zones, Upgrade, Rebirth, Incremental, Simulator, Friends, Fun.
